你不是卡住，是不想再走回舊路 →: You're not stuck. You just don't want the old road. →
有時候你會懷疑自己：「是不是又退步了？怎麼什麼都動不了？」: Sometimes you wonder, "Am I going backwards? Why can't I move at all?"
但很多時候，不是你沒力氣，是你已經不想再用以前的方式過日子了。: Often it isn't that you have no strength. It's that you no longer want to live the way you used to.
舊的路走不下去，新的路還沒看清楚。中間這一段，本來就會停一下。: The old road no longer works, and the new one isn't clear yet. It's natural to pause in between.
這時候要做的不是更用力，而是換一個方向。: What helps here isn't pushing harder. It's changing direction.
寫下一件「以前會做、現在做不下去」的事。它可能正在告訴你：你已經變了。: Write down one thing you used to do but can't bring yourself to do anymore. It may be telling you that you've already changed.
